label: About
description: About as a passport page, the countries as stamps, how the work goes and the questions people ask.

settings.heading: How I work from the road

settings.question: How do you pick where to go next?
settings.answer:
Three things, in this order: how long the visa lets me stay, whether people I trust say the internet holds, and the season. I want to arrive at the start of the good months, not the end.

After that it is usually a bus or a train I want to take.

settings.question: Do you work full time?
settings.answer: Yes. I design software for a company in Europe, so my day starts with calls and the afternoon is mine to walk around. Time zones decide more of the route than scenery does.

settings.question: How do visas work for you?
settings.answer: Mostly on tourist entries, staying well inside the allowed days, and a few digital nomad visas where they exist. I check the rules again before every move, from the government's own pages.

settings.question: What do you do about insurance?
settings.answer: A travel medical policy that covers working abroad, paid monthly, plus a separate policy for the laptop. Both are on the What I use page.

settings.heading: Postcards from the road
settings.text: One email when I move, with what the last place cost. About once a month.
